# API reference {.doc .doc-index}

## Layout widgets

Lumino-backed containers for composing anywidget children.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [LayoutWidget](LayoutWidget.qmd#anylumino.LayoutWidget) | Base class for keyed anywidget composition layouts. |
| [TabPanel](TabPanel.qmd#anylumino.TabPanel) | Lumino tab container for composing child widgets. |
| [BoxPanel](BoxPanel.qmd#anylumino.BoxPanel) | Lumino box layout with configurable direction, spacing, and stretch. |
| [HBox](HBox.qmd#anylumino.HBox) | Horizontal ``BoxPanel`` convenience wrapper. |
| [VBox](VBox.qmd#anylumino.VBox) | Vertical ``BoxPanel`` convenience wrapper. |
| [ScrollBox](ScrollBox.qmd#anylumino.ScrollBox) | Scrollable vertical box for notebook-sized control panels. |
| [SplitPanel](SplitPanel.qmd#anylumino.SplitPanel) | Lumino split panel with draggable dividers between children. |
| [DockPanel](DockPanel.qmd#anylumino.DockPanel) | Lumino dock panel for tabbed or split workspace-style layouts. |
| [AccordionPanel](AccordionPanel.qmd#anylumino.AccordionPanel) | Lumino accordion panel with titled collapsible sections. |
| [StackedPanel](StackedPanel.qmd#anylumino.StackedPanel) | Lumino stacked panel that shows one selected child at a time. |
| [GridPanel](GridPanel.qmd#anylumino.GridPanel) | CSS grid-backed Lumino panel for placing children in grid cells. |
| [ResponsivePanel](ResponsivePanel.qmd#anylumino.ResponsivePanel) | Box layout that switches direction when its width crosses a breakpoint. |

## Astryx base and theme

Shared Astryx wrapper primitives and reusable theme identity.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [astryx.Widget](astryx.Widget.qmd#anylumino.astryx.Widget) | Base anywidget for Astryx-backed components. |
| [astryx.Component](astryx.Component.qmd#anylumino.astryx.Component) | Render a registered Astryx component by name. |
| [astryx.Brand](astryx.Brand.qmd#anylumino.astryx.Brand) | Create a reusable Astryx runtime theme token mapping. |
| [astryx.BuiltTheme](astryx.BuiltTheme.qmd#anylumino.astryx.BuiltTheme) | Create a JSON-safe descriptor for a precompiled Astryx theme. |
| [astryx.Theme](astryx.Theme.qmd#anylumino.astryx.Theme) | Apply a reusable Astryx theme to child widgets. |
